items.text:
Cara eu amo esse jogo, é muito relaxante e estressante ao msm tempo kkk.

A premissa é que você começa do nada, como  uma pessoa que nasceu e cresceu em estações espaciais/naves espaciais. Que após alguns anos trabalhando como pode consegue um nave para si, mas com uma divida nada pequena (mas totalmente pagável). E ai o universo é seu para fazer o que quiser. 

Quer virar um capitão de uma espaçonave com ou sem pessoas ajudando, show vai lá. Quer virar um caçador de recompensas, vai lá tb.  Tem vários locais no sistema solar que você pode ir com o tempo. E é MUITO legal você projetar a SUA NAVE. E ir construindo ela vc mesmo.  

Não tem tradução oficial, mas existe um mod que traduz o jogo pra você, eu prefiro jogar em inglês quando não há uma tradução oficial (até pra manter o meu em dia). A UNICA lastima que eu tenho com esse jogo é que, apesar de ser todo 3d, não existe a possibilidade de ter uma nave em níveis (primeiro andar, segundo, etc). 

Mas é muito massa vc pegar um papel e sair pensando, blz, aqui vai ser a área de carga, aqui eu quero por a sala de controle, aqui vai ser o dormitório, vou por um local pra a galera socializar e comer tb, esse lugar vai ser para o motor nuclear, aqui é a área para ter as baterias e o manter esse povo respirando, nunca fiz um local de exercício vou por aqui então. PQP ESSA É A MINHA NAVE, se alguém quiser tomar ela de nós? (piratas espaciais existe amigo) Vou por umas armas nessa criança...

(PS: Na hora de criar o seu personagem, caso queira, existem sites com todos os eventos de criação do(a) carinha. Não tenha vergonha de pesquisar isso, a sua nave inicial é importante, mas o que você sabe fazer é mais)
items.text_zh:
兄弟，我太爱这个游戏了，它既非常放松又非常让人有压力，哈哈哈。

前提是你从零开始，就像一个在空间站/宇宙飞船上出生和长大的人。在作为能工作的人工作几年后，你为自己弄到了一艘飞船，但背着一笔不小的债务（但完全还得起）。然后宇宙就是你的了，你想做什么就做什么。

你想当一艘太空船的船长，有没有人帮忙都行，好，去吧。你想当赏金猎人，也去吧。太阳系里有很多地方，随着时间推移你可以去。而且设计你自己的飞船真的超级酷。而且你自己一点点把它建起来。

没有官方翻译，但有一个模组可以为你翻译这个游戏，当没有官方翻译时我更喜欢用英语玩（也是为了保持我的英语水平）。我对这个游戏唯一的遗憾是，尽管它全是3D的，却不能拥有多层级的飞船（第一层、第二层等等）。

但拿一张纸然后开始想，好吧，这里会是货舱区，这里我想放控制室，这里会是宿舍，我还要放一个让大家社交和吃饭的地方，这个地方用来放核发动机，这里是放电池和让这些人呼吸的区域，我从来没做过锻炼区，那我就放这里吧。我靠，这是我的飞船，如果有人想从我们手里抢走它呢？（太空海盗是存在的，朋友）我要给这孩子装点武器……

（附注：创建你的角色时，如果你愿意，有些网站列出了角色创建的所有事件。别不好意思去查这个，你的初始飞船很重要，但你会做什么更重要）

observations.description: 游戏虽然是全3D，但不支持建造多层结构的飞船。
observations.evidence: apesar de ser todo 3d, não existe a possibilidade de ter uma nave em níveis (primeiro andar, segundo, etc)
observations.evidence_zh: 尽管全是3D的，却不可能拥有一艘分层的飞船（一层、二层等等）

items.text:
i get why this game has mixed reviews. there is some truly honest to god awful ♥♥♥♥ in it. the developer quips need to just be removed (this isn't a marvel movie, i'm trying to take your serious setting seriously lol), the UI/UX/item management needs drastic improvement, docking and undocking takes way more clicks that it should, insane lack of verisimilitude for a 1.0 release (two bags the entirety of the game. you expect me to believe this literally solar system spanning society is reliant on TWO types of bags and theyre not even actual backpacks?) the tutorial ends abruptly after touching on just the basics. that last point is the most devastating, just like Kitfoxs other game Neo-Scavenger, most players are going to (reasonably) get caught up in the minutiae without ever getting to the "game proper" which is everything outside of the first area.

the learning curve is steep and barely visible without context, but its there. each major location across the solar system is designed to teach the player something. k-leg, the first major area the player spends time in includes the aforementioned tutorial, but it doesn't explain ANYTHING about shipbuilding which is arguably what the entire area is supposed to be teaching you since you literally won't be able to get anywhere (not even to the outer reaches of the k-leg boneyard) without at least modifying your starter ship. that is the most egregious thing about this game. because if you can get past k-leg, then you really get to the bulk of the game.

inner system travel teaches you how to use a torch drive both manually and with plots. venus introduces an entirely new atmospheric ship building system and ship racing. ceres makes you forget everything you've learned and build entirely for ship combat or mining. all of these areas are fun and even the story is kind of engaging... but it's all hidden behind a starting area that doesn't teach you the mechanic it requires you to master in order to "beat" it.  that being said, if you put in the time and learn all these systems, it's great. nothing like coursing through the void beating your meat. no seriously, beat your meat while in deep space and see what happens.
items.text_zh:
我明白为什么这款游戏评价褒贬不一了。里面确实有一些真他妈糟糕的玩意儿。开发者的俏皮话就该直接删掉（这又不是漫威电影，我可是在认真对待你那严肃的设定啊哈哈），UI/UX/物品管理需要大幅改进，对接和脱离对接需要的点击次数远超应有，对于一个1.0正式版来说，拟真度低得离谱（整个游戏就两种包。你指望我相信这个横跨整个太阳系的社会就靠两种包，而且它们甚至都不是真正的背包？）教程在只讲了最基础的东西之后就戛然而止。最后一点是最要命的，就像Kitfox的另一款游戏Neo-Scavenger一样，大多数玩家会（合理地）陷入细枝末节中，永远到不了“真正的游戏”部分，也就是第一个区域之外的一切。

学习曲线很陡峭，没有背景的话几乎看不出来，但它确实存在。太阳系中的每个主要地点都旨在教会玩家一些东西。k-leg，玩家花时间待的第一个主要区域，包含了前面提到的教程，但它完全没有解释任何关于造船的内容，而按理说这整个区域本该教你的就是这个，因为如果不至少改装你的初始飞船，你 literally 哪儿都去不了（连k-leg废船场的边缘都到不了）。这是这款游戏最离谱的地方。因为如果你能熬过k-leg，那你才真正接触到游戏的主体。

内太阳系旅行教你如何手动和使用航线来操作火炬驱动器。金星引入了一套全新的大气层内造船系统和飞船竞速。谷神星让你忘掉学过的一切，完全围绕飞船战斗或采矿来建造。所有这些区域都很有趣，甚至剧情也算引人入胜……但这一切都藏在一个起始区域后面，而这个区域并不教你它要求你掌握才能“通关”的机制。话虽如此，如果你投入时间学会所有这些系统，那就很棒。没有什么比在虚空中穿行打飞机更爽的了。不，说真的，在深空里打飞机看看会发生什么。

observations.description: 整个游戏只有两种包，缺乏真实感
observations.evidence: two bags the entirety of the game. you expect me to believe this literally solar system spanning society is reliant on TWO types of bags and theyre not even actual backpacks?
observations.evidence_zh: 两个袋子就是整个游戏的全部。你指望我相信这个字面意义上横跨太阳系的社会只依赖两种袋子，而且它们甚至都不是真正的背包？

items.text:
6/10
 -- [!! F U N !!   BUT   D I S A P O I N T I N G] --

My hour count is a result of a lack of games to play, nevertheless,  this game has been fun but at every moment past the 15hr mark I've thought to myself "where's the content?"

Essentially if you're the type that enjoys grindy and overly complicated complete freedom sandbox games (kenshi, rimworld, etc), then you'll enjoy it, but likely come to the same opinion as me.

------------------------------------------
SHIP BUILDING AND DESIGN LACKS SERIOUS DEPTH
      Half the game is grinding away at building your space ship, yet there is so little to build decoration and functionality wise. You have two types of chairs, three types of tables, and no real interior decoration other than painfully matching correct floor variants you rarely find (like 5 decor items I can think of that aren't those).
     For functional parts, you just need a ship battery, thruster, pilot seat, and two air pumps (one for O2 and N2). Then you have your fully functional space ship with it's core systems and sadly, it doesn't get much more in depth than that beyond building your first ship's fusion reactor. Like theres no need to build a dedicated life support room on your ship, managing lifesupport systems is as simple as placing an air pump inside a room. It doesn't even matter where you place your thrusters, sensors, or anything. As long as if it's on the ship it flies. It just really feels lackluster, like there's no solar panels, no ship shield room to set-up, no crafting room, etc. The variety for what is there is also very limited. You'd expect water to be an important resource in space, but it's not here. You'll just be storing gallons in your fridge.
-------------------------------------------
LACKING LOOT VARIETY
You'll always be finding the same exact stuff in chests and crates aboard every single ship. Its not exciting.
------------------------------------------
WORTHLESS TRAITS
Theres a wide plethora of traits in character creation, half of which no one has any clue as to what they do. Is cooking a hobby? Well thats never coming up again, and your not going to be cooking anything because its not a feature. Theres just so much that does truely nothing
------------------------------------------
LACKING QOL
There's just so so so much QOL that is lacking, especially when it comes to ship design. Character pathfinding is awful and dumb. Theres a ship building mode in the game, but you cannot import your designs or ANYTHING made in that mode to the real game. There is no planning mode. Darkness always makes building difficult, you can never get a full view of your ship you are working on. To remedy this you can use a 'visor' such as a 'price visor' which removes the darkness and color codes items by their relative value. But in that mode you cannot see any orders you have issued, any walls you set to be constructed, flooring you just ordered your character to put down, etc.
------------------------------------------
VERY ANNOYING CHARACTER NEED BAR MANAGEMENT
Your character has mental needs, such as socialization, talking to family, etc. To solve these it is a tedious task of right clicking your character, and pressing the correct hotkey that lowers the need bar over 20 times or be penalized stat wise. Im not joking, it's incredibly stupid. You will literally spend 3 minutes IRL spam clicking "browse social media, long for a better love life, remember family, etc" to make your need bars go down to keep your character happy. These systems ARE NOT ENGAGING IN ANY WAY and are my biggest gripe with the game.
------------------------------------------
!! BUGGY & UNOPTIMIZED!!
Admittedly, I haven't experience a save breaking bug a save and reload can't fix, but it's annoying coming across bugs that require you to reload the game in order to continue playing. Also, runs a bit hot for what it is and saving and loading takes ages.
------------------------------------------

-- THE REASON THIS IS A POSITIVE REVIEW STILL --
At the end of it all, I still enjoy this game but am disappointed constantly. What is keeping me playing is the exploration and that sense of progression. There really is a ton to explore, space is huge in this game. But the progression is what is really keeping me coming back, you start with rags and work your way to riches and that is just incredibly fun and well done in this game.
items.text_zh:
6/10
 -- [!! 有 趣 !!   但   令 人 失 望] --

我的游戏时长是因为没什么别的游戏可玩，尽管如此，这游戏一直挺有趣，但过了15小时之后，我每时每刻都在想“内容在哪？”

基本上，如果你是那种喜欢肝、过于复杂、完全自由的沙盒游戏（kenshi、rimworld等）的人，那你会喜欢它，但很可能最终得出和我一样的看法。

------------------------------------------
飞船建造和设计严重缺乏深度
      游戏的一半时间都花在建造你的太空飞船上，但在装饰和功能方面可建造的东西却少得可怜。你只有两种椅子、三种桌子，除了那些你很少能找到的、需要痛苦地匹配正确的地板变体之外，没有任何真正的室内装饰（我能想到的除了那些之外大概只有5种装饰物品）。
     至于功能部件，你只需要一个飞船电池、推进器、驾驶座和两个气泵（一个用于O2，一个用于N2）。然后你就有了拥有核心系统的完全可用的太空飞船，可悲的是，除了建造你第一艘飞船的聚变反应堆之外，它并不会变得更有深度。就像你不需要在飞船上建造专门的生命维持室，管理生命维持系统就像在房间里放一个气泵一样简单。你把推进器、传感器或其他任何东西放在哪里都无所谓。只要它在飞船上，它就能飞。这真的让人感觉很乏味，就像没有太阳能板、没有需要设置的飞船护盾室、没有制作室等等。现有的东西种类也非常有限。你会以为水在太空中是一种重要资源，但这里不是。你只会把几加仑水储存在冰箱里。
-------------------------------------------
战利品缺乏多样性
你在每一艘飞船上的箱子和板条箱里总是会找到完全相同的东西。这并不令人兴奋。
------------------------------------------
毫无价值的特质
角色创建中有大量特质，其中一半没人知道它们到底有什么用。烹饪是一种爱好吗？嗯，这再也不会出现了，而且你也不会烹饪任何东西，因为它不是一个功能。有太多东西真的什么都不做
------------------------------------------
缺乏生活质量改进
缺乏的生活质量改进实在是太多太多了，尤其是在飞船设计方面。角色寻路糟糕又愚蠢。游戏里有一个飞船建造模式，但你不能把你的设计或在该模式中制作的任何东西导入到真正的游戏中。没有规划模式。黑暗总是让建造变得困难，你永远无法完整地看到你正在建造的飞船。为了解决这个问题，你可以使用一个“面罩”，比如“价格面罩”，它会消除黑暗并根据物品的相对价值给它们上色。但在那个模式下，你看不到你发出的任何命令、你设置为要建造的任何墙壁、你刚刚命令角色铺设的地板等等。
------------------------------------------
非常烦人的角色需求条管理
你的角色有心理需求，比如社交、与家人交谈等等。要解决这些需求，就得繁琐地右键点击你的角色，然后按正确的热键超过20次来降低需求条，否则就会受到属性惩罚。我不是开玩笑，这蠢得难以置信。你真的会花3分钟在现实中狂点“浏览社交媒体、渴望更好的爱情生活、想念家人等等”，让你的需求条降下来，以保持你的角色开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
!! 有BUG且未优化!!
诚然，我还没有遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档BUG，但遇到需要你重新加载游戏才能继续玩的BUG还是很烦人。而且，就它这个体量来说，运行起来有点烫，保存和加载也要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

-- 这仍然是一条好评的原因 --
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这个游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种进步感。确实有大量东西可以探索，这个游戏里的太空非常巨大。但真正让我不断回来的是进度推进，你从衣衫褴褛开始，一路努力走向富有，这在这游戏里真的非常有趣，而且做得很好。
让你的角色保持开心。这些系统在任何方面都毫无吸引力，是我对这款游戏最大的不满。
------------------------------------------
！！有漏洞且未优化！！
诚然，我还没遇到过保存并重新加载无法修复的坏档漏洞，但遇到需要重新加载游戏才能继续游玩的漏洞还是很烦人。另外，就它这个体量而言，运行起来有点烫，而且保存和加载要花很长时间。
------------------------------------------

—— 这仍然是一条好评的原因 ——
归根结底，我仍然喜欢这款游戏，但也不断感到失望。让我继续玩下去的是探索和那种成长感。这款游戏里真的有太多东西可以探索，太空非常浩瀚。但真正让我不断回来的还是成长进程，你从衣衫褴褛起步，一路打拼到腰缠万贯，而这在这款游戏里就是极其有趣，而且做得非常好。

observations.description: 飞船建造和设计缺乏深度，装饰和功能部件种类少
observations.evidence: SHIP BUILDING AND DESIGN LACKS SERIOUS DEPTH
observations.evidence_zh: 飞船建造和设计缺乏真正的深度

items.text:
All in all, a nice game. 
But still lacks content in my opinion. There are far too few different ship parts and ship hulls in the game. And after the initial learning curve, which isn't really that steep, the game is also not that hard.
There are not enough dangers in derelicts, making them mostly loot bags.
Building your own space ship is fun, but is also hampered by the limited variety of parts there are.

Would still recommend, as what is there is well made and fun, but I would love to see more content in the future.
items.text_zh:
总而言之，是款不错的游戏。
但在我看来仍然缺乏内容。游戏里的不同飞船部件和船体实在太少了。而且过了最初的学习曲线之后——其实也没那么陡——游戏也没那么难。
废弃飞船里的危险不够多，让它们大多成了战利品袋。
建造自己的太空飞船很有趣，但也受限于部件种类有限而受到拖累。

还是会推荐，因为现有的内容做得很好也很有趣，但我希望未来能看到更多内容。

observations.evidence: Building your own space ship is fun, but is also hampered by the limited variety of parts there are.
observations.evidence_zh: 建造自己的太空飞船很有趣，但也因可用部件种类有限而受到限制。

items.text:
I bought this game a couple years ago but decided to wait for further development after half an hour. Recently a friend tried it and so I decided to give it another chance.
I have put 40 hours into it this week.

This game has a lot of issues. Inventory micromangement is terrible, a lot of tasks that seem like they should be handled automatically by autotask aren't (swapping batteries is the most notable), there isn't much content in some areas such as equipment with most functional ship parts having only one example per class, it often stutters for unclear reasons, as far as I am aware you get no information on the price of a new employee until after you hire them, there is no automation of transferring gasses between canisters, the list goes on.
I recommend this game because it is heavily systems driven with things like atmospheric pressure and gravity/acceleration being very well modeled while the core loop of going and ripping things apart to sell to stay alive is to me extremely satisfying. The steady progression of struggling debt slave to small business owner is one I wish more games had.
items.text_zh:
我几年前买了这款游戏，但在玩了半小时后决定等待进一步开发。最近一个朋友试了试，所以我决定再给它一次机会。
我这周已经投入了40个小时。

这款游戏有很多问题。物品栏微观管理很糟糕，很多看起来应该由自动任务自动处理的任务并没有（换电池是最明显的），某些领域内容不多，比如装备，大多数功能性飞船部件每个等级只有一个例子，它经常因为不明原因卡顿，据我所知，在你雇佣新员工之前你得不到关于他们价格的任何信息，没有在罐之间转移气体的自动化，这样的例子还有很多。
我推荐这款游戏，因为它高度系统驱动，像大气压力和重力/加速度这样的东西被建模得非常好，而出去拆东西卖钱以求生存的核心循环对我来说极其令人满足。从挣扎的债务奴隶到小企业主的稳定 progression 是我希望更多游戏能有的。

observations.evidence_zh: 某些方面的内容不多，比如装备方面，大多数可用的飞船部件每个等级只有一个例子

items.text:
One of the few games that compensate for lack of fancy graphics or 3D world with sheer gameplay. You salvage, you mine, you build, you earn and survive, all aboard veritable coffins that are proudly called 'spacecrafts'. Sadly this is marred by a legion of game-breaking issues.

Pros:
- Developers nailed the art style and made a game that matches it
- Variety of mechanics, lots of different things to do
- Space with 'physics' done in a fun way, you use Newtonian physics to travel instead of fighting it
- Sensor gameplay and space combat

Pain Points:
- AI is broken. NPCs sleeping on the floor, drinking water till they are nauseous, stealing your food, denying you docking to one of your ship are just toppings. NPCs walking into fires for food, going into N2-only atmosphere without a helmet, ramming planets, picking fights with police and exterminating police population... NPCs don't live very long, but that's still not the worst of it. What takes the cake: ramming player, venting player's atmosphere, flinging player into the planet, accelerating player to 2km/s in seconds (when you have 1km/s delta-v)... that's the game's norm for the NPCs.
- Game has depth but player has little to affect that depth. As an example oxygen and atmosphere overall are detailed yet there is no airlock (only a mislabeled docking port) so you choice is to cheat by fusing yourself with the docking port or to let atmosphere out. No proper atmosphere distribution either (the bigger the ship the more apparent it becomes). Medical conditions are detailed, yet there is very little feedback for yourself and no option at all to treat NPCs. Fuel and power can't be transferred between ships, sans dragging massive tanks around. Sensors aren't configurable.
- BUGS. Dialogues get stack; 'Resume action' button sometimes doesn't work (lacks error feedback?); Autopause doesn't work half the time; NPCs can't wake up; Jump cables take longer to install than proper cables.

Cons:
- Inventory. The bigger your ship the more frustating it becomes (like having multiple bins full of bags, cargo pants in those bags, just to store small items like spare parts and food).
- You have to baby-sit a lot of actions (malfucntioning autopause doesn't help).
- Orders have no proper queue or priorities.
- Lack of variety in a lot of aspects, especially for ships (Ex: a single RCS, single power source). Quite a few derelicts are practically new because there is no 'obsolete' parts or technologies. Damage could have had more depth too. 
- Progression needs refining
- Overall incomplete.

I want to love this game, but at this point the game is not worth it. The game is only half done.
items.text_zh:
这是少数几款用纯粹的游戏玩法弥补了缺乏华丽画面或3D世界的游戏之一。你打捞、你采矿、你建造、你赚钱并生存，这一切都在名副其实的棺材上，它们被自豪地称为“宇宙飞船”。遗憾的是，这被一大堆破坏游戏的问题所玷污。

优点：
- 开发者敲定了美术风格，并做出了一款与之匹配的游戏
- 机制多样，有很多不同的事情可做
- 太空“物理”以有趣的方式呈现，你利用牛顿物理学来移动，而不是与之对抗
- 传感器玩法和太空战斗

痛点：
- AI坏了。NPC睡在地板上、喝水喝到恶心、偷你的食物、拒绝让你停靠到你自己的一艘船上，这些还只是小菜。NPC为了食物走进火里、不戴头盔进入只有氮气的大气、撞行星、挑衅警察并灭绝警察人口……NPC活不了多久，但这还不是最糟的。最离谱的是：撞玩家、排放玩家的大气、把玩家甩进行星、在几秒内把玩家加速到2公里/秒（当你只有1公里/秒的Δv时）……这就是游戏中NPC的常态。
- 游戏有深度，但玩家几乎无法影响这种深度。例如，氧气和整体大气做得很细致，却没有气闸（只有一个标错的对接端口），所以你的选择要么是把自己和对接端口融合在一起作弊，要么就是把大气放出去。也没有合适的大气分配（船越大就越明显）。医疗状况做得很细致，但你几乎得不到关于自身的反馈，也完全没有治疗NPC的选项。燃料和电力无法在飞船之间转移，除非拖着巨大的储罐到处跑。传感器不可配置。
- BUG。对话会堆叠；“恢复动作”按钮有时不起作用（缺少错误反馈？）；自动暂停一半时间都不工作；NPC无法醒来；跨接电缆安装起来比正规电缆还久。

缺点：
- 物品栏。你的船越大就越令人沮丧（就像有多个装满袋子的箱子，袋子里还有工装裤，只是为了存放备件和食物之类的小物品）。
- 很多操作你都得亲自盯着（自动暂停失灵更是雪上加霜）。
- 命令没有合适的队列或优先级。
- 很多方面缺乏多样性，尤其是飞船（例如：只有一个RCS、一个电源）。相当多的废弃船实际上几乎是新的，因为没有“过时”的部件或技术。损伤本也可以更有深度。
- 进度需要改进
- 总体不完整。

我想爱上这款游戏，但就目前而言，这游戏不值得。这游戏只完成了一半。

items.text:
Love the game but be aware than only the ship building (control panel) part work. The space-sim social part of the game is broken and doesn't really work. Also, the traits at the character creation doesn't seem randomized.

The game also lack of self-knowledge. I mean by that than you need to go deep into an obscure discord to find the information you need about basic and obvious stuff and you are not even sure to find it. The community is great to help you but for this type of game, you should expect to be able to go on your own without asking. 

You should also know than for a ship builder, there is a lack of component parts to choose. There is maybe two different reactor to build and a bunch of rooms who have their own identity, for the rest, they recycle items use in other rooms. 

Apart from the starting location, there is not much to do. All the scrapyard are there, the second one is at Venus. The rest of the game is just about traveling at 3G to do trading.

There is station here and there, everywhere in the solar system, but since the social interaction is still a work in process, don't expect to find any point of interest to do there. No quest, no story. 

Even after 100 hours, i prefer to warn the newcomers. The game is dev since 2020 and is still in early state. I prefer saying the truth than lying. 

Even if i like the game, i don't see why i would progress further since the game is really repetitive and consist mostly into uninstalling always the same 10 components who have a sort of value at the market. (Yeah, market doesn't evolve, it's always the same parts who have some value, the rest is just scraps you left behind).

Anyway, 4 years in dev and so little achieve, i can't put a good review even if i enjoyed my time playing. There is other game who have smaller crew and who did better than this.

See this as a lifetime project from a guy who left the AAA industry to start a business on his own to pay the bill. There is thousand of project like that on steam sadly. At the end, the player will, again, have to wait x years to get a finish product.
items.text_zh:
喜欢这个游戏，但要注意只有飞船建造（控制面板）部分能正常工作。游戏的太空模拟社交部分坏掉了，实际上并不能正常运作。另外，角色创建时的特质似乎也不是随机化的。

游戏还缺乏自知之明。我的意思是，你需要深入一个晦涩的Discord才能找到关于基本和显而易见的东西所需的信息，而且你甚至不确定能否找到。社区很乐于帮助你，但对于这种类型的游戏，你应该期望能够自己独立进行而无需询问。

你还应该知道，对于一个飞船建造者来说，可供选择的组件部件很缺乏。可能只有两种不同的反应堆可以建造，还有一堆各自有自己身份的房间，至于其余的，他们回收利用其他房间里使用的物品。

除了起始地点之外，没有太多可做的事情。所有的废料场都在那里，第二个在金星。游戏的其余部分就只是在3G下旅行来做贸易。

太阳系各处到处都有空间站，但由于社交互动仍在开发中，不要指望在那里能找到任何值得关注的事情可做。没有任务，没有故事。

即使在100小时之后，我还是更愿意警告新来者。这个游戏从2020年开始开发，仍处于早期阶段。我宁愿说真话也不愿撒谎。

即使我喜欢这个游戏，我也看不出我为什么要继续推进，因为游戏真的很重复，主要就是不断卸载那同样的10个在市场上有点价值的组件。（是的，市场不会演变，总是同样的部件有价值，其余的就只是你丢下的废料）。

总之，开发了4年却成就如此之少，即使我享受了玩游戏的时光，我也无法给出好评。还有其他团队规模更小的游戏做得比这个更好。

把这看作是一个离开AAA行业、自己创业来付账单的人的一生项目。遗憾的是，Steam上有成千上万个这样的项目。最终，玩家将再次不得不等待X年才能得到一个完成的产品。

items.text:
If your a fan of survival games like Classic Fallout and TV shows like Firefly your going to enjoy Ostranausts! This is the Scifi adventure game I've always dreamed someone would build, low graphics but deep story building, game play and lore. 

Big fan of Neo Scavenger! When I first saw this game, on steam, one year ago, I kept it in my wish list with hopes it would update and develop. A year later I bought the game and I couldn't be happier. For me Blue Bottle games never disappoints. They are building a game that is full of lore, depth and mysteries to uncover. I'VE LOVED EVERY MINUTE!. 

Pros:
Form ship flying, to ship building and learning how to micro manage successfully. I've been hooked by the many processes and options you are given. Its been so interesting learning how to figure things out. You can build and customise in this game that fun and very rewarding. The challenge of keeping all these moving parts together and navigating your way through the many pitfall has kept me gripped. You can achieve so much very quickly and also loss it all just as fast. I haven't even begun and i m excited by what I've sen so far.

Social interactions with NPC builds a story of its own. When I started the game I thought nothing of making enemies with NPCs but man I was so wrong. I've been ambushed, attacked and hunted by NPCs who I've made enemies of. If it wasn't for my combat knife or a hacksaw in my pocket I would have died many times. it makes the game fun by adding an extra element to think about while getting supplies or exploring.  

Cons:
A lot of bugs, but it's beta and that's  to be expected. As the game has gone on I've crashed many times due to mapping errors and dead NPCs stacking up in places like KLeg.

Flying your ship is so hard and not rewarding. For me I used the insta travel a lot. The manually piloting mini game and docking is just so exhausting. I don't have the spacial awareness to keep track of all the moving dots on screen. NPC ships crash into you so much and its frustrating. You can also be in the middle of docking/undocking your ship and get patrols wanting to board you or give you a 5000 cash fine for failing to comply. Its a learning curve I don't enjoy learning, I avoid it like the plague. If I could hire an NPC to pilot my ship for me, which I haven't tried...yet, I definitely would. it would be fun to have a star trek like NPC crew to navigate/communicate the space travel. 

YOU CAN NOT CUSTOMISE YOUR SUIT! For me this needs to be a feature. I was so disappointed that you can only have two types of space suits. I hope Blue Bottle are working on this for future updates. Adding straps, buckles and extra utilises to you suit would be so great and compliment the great ship building features. Scavenging for suit parts and adding low budget bit, in a survivalist like, makeshift type way, would be so much fun. The challenge of having your suit needing repairs and patching it up, fully repairing or dismantling it is something i am hoping for. Having a suit of many different parts that you found, restored and built yourself, is rewarding. Every part would have its own story of how you found it or had to build it. Customising a suit that works for your needs would make the early game even more interesting because your invested in creating just like in ship building. Having a costume suit for different types of situation or adding gun belts or holders for items would take the Scavenging to another level of enjoyment as you progress in game. A suit with a jet pack would be a fun end game item. 

All in all this Game is a 6 out of 10. I can see the amazing potential of this game. IN MY OPINION, What this game is and whats it can become is unlimited. With time and investment this gem will turn into an absolute diamond of game. KEEP UP THE GREAT WORK BLUE BOTTLE GAMES!
items.text_zh:
如果你是《经典辐射》这类生存游戏和《萤火虫》这类电视剧的粉丝，你会喜欢Ostranausts的！这是我一直梦想有人能做出的科幻冒险游戏，画面简陋但故事构建、玩法和背景设定都很深厚。

我是Neo Scavenger的超级粉丝！一年前我第一次在Steam上看到这款游戏时，就把它留在愿望单里，希望它能更新和发展。一年后我买了这款游戏，开心得不得了。对我来说，Blue Bottle Games从不让人失望。他们正在打造一款充满背景设定、深度和待解谜团的游戏。我爱它的每一分钟！

优点：
从飞船飞行，到飞船建造，再到学习如何成功地进行微观管理。我被游戏提供的众多流程和选项深深吸引。摸索出各种门道的过程太有意思了。你在这款游戏里可以建造和自定义，既有趣又非常有成就感。让所有这些活动部件保持运转、在众多陷阱中摸索前行的挑战让我欲罢不能。你可以很快取得很多成就，也能同样快地失去一切。我甚至还没真正开始，就已经被目前看到的东西激动到了。

与NPC的社交互动会构建出属于它自己的故事。刚开始玩的时候，我根本没把和NPC结仇当回事，但天哪，我错得太离谱了。我被那些与我结仇的NPC伏击、攻击和追猎。要不是口袋里有战斗刀或钢锯，我早就死了很多次了。这给游戏增添了额外的思考要素，在获取补给或探索时让游戏更有趣。

缺点：
很多bug，但这是测试版，也在意料之中。随着游戏进行，我因为地图错误和死掉的NPC在KLeg之类的地方堆积而崩溃了很多次。

驾驶飞船太难了，而且没有回报。对我来说，我经常用瞬间旅行。手动驾驶小游戏和对接实在太累人了。我没有那种空间感知能力，没法追踪屏幕上所有移动的小点。NPC飞船老是撞上你，真让人沮丧。你还可能在对接/脱离飞船的过程中，遇到巡逻队想登船检查，或者因为你没服从就给你开5000现金的罚单。这是我并不享受学习的学习曲线，我像躲瘟疫一样避开它。如果我能雇一个NPC替我驾驶飞船——我还没试过……暂时还没——我肯定会雇的。有一个像《星际迷航》那样的NPC船员来导航/沟通太空旅行会很有趣。

你不能自定义你的宇航服！对我来说这必须成为一个功能。我很失望你只能有两种类型的宇航服。我希望Blue Bottle正在为未来的更新做这件事。给你的宇航服加上绑带、扣环和额外的实用配件会非常棒，也能与出色的飞船建造功能相得益彰。以生存主义者那种临时拼凑的方式搜寻宇航服零件并加上低预算的小部件，会非常有趣。我希望能有这样一个挑战：你的宇航服需要修理，你要给它打补丁、完全修复或拆解它。拥有一套由你找到、修复并亲手建造的许多不同零件组成的宇航服，是很有成就感的。每个零件都会有它自己的故事，讲述你是怎么找到它或不得不建造它的。自定义一套适合你需求的宇航服会让游戏前期更加有趣，因为你会像在飞船建造中那样投入到创造之中。为不同类型的情况准备一套服装式宇航服，或者加上枪带或物品固定装置，会把搜寻的乐趣提升到另一个层次，随着你在游戏中推进。一套带喷气背包的宇航服会是个有趣的终局物品。

总而言之，这款游戏我打6分（满分10分）。我能看到这款游戏惊人的潜力。在我看来，这款游戏现在是什么样，以及它能变成什么样，都是无限的。有了时间和投入，这块宝石会变成一款绝对的钻石级游戏。继续加油，BLUE BOTTLE GAMES！
